subject: Call time change
text:
We need to move Thursday's call to 6 p.m. instead of 3 p.m. The professor's office is available then, and the lab access pass will already be renewed.

The reason for the change is simple: the funding application came back approved with more than the minimum amount, which is an unexpectedly good outcome. That means I can book the printing and travel costs before the call, but I have to submit the revised budget by 5 p.m.

Keep the same agenda. Bring the draft timeline, the contact list, and the notes from last week's workshop. Please note that the approval notice may also affect the shared account, so bring the account summary if you already have it. If 6 p.m. does not work, pick a slot after 7 p.m. or tomorrow evening; otherwise we should confirm within the hour. Reply with yes or no soon.

Student
